ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){try{var h=''+result;var mb=h.match(/var\s+pasd\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/)||h.match(/(https:\/\/image\d*\.wmanhua\.com\/mh\/[0-9a-f]+\/[0-9a-f\-]+\/)/);if(!mb){return '';}var base=mb[1];if(base.charAt(base.length-1)!='/'){base+='/';}var mn=h.match(/var\s+num\s*=\s*eval\("(\d+)"\)/)||h.match(/var\s+num\s*=\s*(\d+)/);var n=mn?parseInt(mn[1]):0;if(!n){return '';}var out='';for(var i=1;i<=n;i++){out+='';}return out;}catch(e){return '';}})()

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){try{var u=''+baseUrl;var m=u.match(/\/comic\/(\d+)/);if(!m){m=(''+result).match(/\/comic\/(\d+)/);}if(!m){return [];}var id=m[1];var headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Referer':'https://source.wmanhua.com/','User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; SM-G973F) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/89.0.4389.105 Mobile Safari/537.36'};var resp=java.post('https://source.wmanhua.com/comic/'+id,'{}',headers);var obj=JSON.parse(resp.body());var list=(obj&&obj.data&&obj.data.chapters)?obj.data.chapters:null;if(!list){return [];}var arr=[];for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){var c=list[i];arr.push({chapterName:String(c.chapterName||c.name||''),chapterUrl:'https://source.wmanhua.com/chapter/'+id+'-'+c.id+'.html'});}arr.reverse();return arr;}catch(e){return [];}})()
